Tomato dosai
By: Harini Mukundhan
Published: Sunday, March 16, 2014 - 8:40pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 cup raw rice
4-5 tomatoes
2 green chillies
2 dried red chillies
1/2 teaspoon asafoetida
1 small piece of ginger
Salt

Preparation

1 Soak raw rice in water for around 2 hours.Drain and grind to a smooth paste along with all the other ingredients.Batter should be of normal dosa batter consistency. 2 Heat a tava with little oil.Make thin dosas.Serve with chutney.

About

Here is a very very tasty and instant dosai recipe.Tomato dosa is a very very easy to make crepe with hot and sour taste.This can be prepared in a jiffy as it doesn't need much planning.The ingredients are also very simple ones mostly available in the pantry.Do try this very tasty and simple one.Tomato dosai (Crepe made with tomato and rice)
